ledger.x: 959: the Ismaili / Qarmatian dynasty replaces the Banu Munabbih.
1006: Mahmud of Ghazni marches on Multan.

wars.name: Ghaznavid conquest of Multan
wars.outcome: Mahmud marched on Multan in 1006 because of its Isma'ili element and Daud's defection, and again in 1010 during his eighth invasion of India; Daud was imprisoned at Ghurak and Multan annexed.

certainty.note: No frontier is given on any page; the radius round Multan is approximate.
